readings.Aries: You've been holding a position past the point where holding it costs more than releasing it. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Taurus: There is something you've been meaning to create that you keep postponing. Today is not different, but you could make it be. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Gemini: You are most yourself when surprised. Create the conditions for it today. The first instinct was right.
readings.Cancer: Safety is the precondition for everything you do best. Build it deliberately. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Leo: You want the room. You also sometimes want to be unknown. Both are real. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Virgo: Your body is communicating something your mind has been too busy to register. Listen. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Libra: The person you've been gentle with needs something less gentle today. You can do that. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Scorpio: Your instinct for what people really mean is almost always correct. It's protecting you today. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Sagittarius: The map is useful. The territory is better. Go off-map today. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Capricorn: Someone you respect is watching and taking notes. Good. You know what you're doing. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Aquarius: The paradox you've been carrying is that you believe in human connection and maintain great distance from it. Close some. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Pisces: Your inner life is extraordinarily rich. The outer life sometimes doesn't know what to do with it. The window for this is shorter than it looks.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
